_note: Kept as a worked example; paths are relative to the repo root. The source video is not included: to rebuild these shots, download a 1920x1080 copy of youtube.com/watch?v=rscb1DgJtNg (Chase's own public video) to the `video` path; the deck README has the yt-dlp command. `bubble_prior` is where the author's webcam bubble sits in that video. The s09 tiles read docs/styles.png from the public animate repo: clone github.com/cth9191/animate next to this repo (../animate). The built PNGs (shots/*.png) are not included either.

shots.name: s01-claude-wordmark
shots.note: Low-effort one-prompt reel, mid-orbit: all six letters C-L-A-U-D-E legible on the orange ring. Exact 16:9 crop of the reel's picture area (letterbox bars removed), centred on the ring. Bubble area rebuilt by mirroring the symmetric tick ring about the ring's centre line (seamless clone); HUD timecode top right is part of the reel.

shots.name: s01-claude-wordmark-settled
shots.note: ALT for the cover or slide 10: same reel 0.75 s later, letters settled, with 'MOTION DESIGN · SHOWREEL 2026' and the small line 'every frame of this was written in code'. Same 16:9 crop.

shots.name: s02-not-ai-video
shots.note: Both 'drawn by hand' and 'AI video' fully struck through, wave still drawn (next frame starts the transition). The bubble hid the box's bottom-right corner: rebuilt from the mirror-symmetric bottom-left corner. Blue pi-creature fragment next to the bubble is outside the crop.

shots.name: s04-pipeline
shots.note: Full row: code box -> headless browser -> frames = 216 -> FFmpeg -> play button, plus the sound(t) wave with its arrow up into FFmpeg. Only flat dark background was under the bubble (flat fill with the sampled ground); the arrow runs 2-5 px outside the bubble edge, so content pixels in the pad band are kept ('protect').

shots.name: s05-before
shots.note: BEFORE: 12-frame contact sheet, 5 frames flagged with orange boxes (t=8.5, 10, 12, 15, 18), 'label cut off' note, code line shows 590 underlined. Same crop as s05-after. Only flat dark background was under the bubble.

shots.name: s05-after
shots.note: AFTER: same sheet, labels back inside the frames, checkmarks under the 5 fixed frames, code now reads 520. Same crop as s05-before.

shots.name: s06-storyboard
shots.note: The storyboard card 'A video is a function: storyboard' with all 7 panels, timings and sound notes. The zoomed-in moments (6:23, 6:50-6:53) are an editor zoom of the same recording and cut off panels 4-7, so the full card at native size is the sharpest complete view. Crop is the card inset 2 px; the bubble only covered the card's empty bottom-right (flat #291F19), corners squared in the same colour.

shots.name: s08-explainer
shots.note: One-shot explainer beat 'same t, same picture': frame(6.99) = frame(6.99), two circle-and-wave panels. The bubble hid the bottom of the right label's closing bracket: rebuilt from the identical left label, 866 px to the left (measured by matching the two labels). Crop stops above the pi creature peeking from behind the bubble.

shots.name: s08-reel
shots.note: Low-effort reel, '04 - SPACE' / DIMENSION beat: neon knot + wireframe icosahedron over a perspective grid floor. Same 16:9 crop as the cover shot. Bubble covered only floor grid and navy background; rebuilt by mirroring the symmetric floor.

shots.name: s08-remake
shots.note: LEFT = a third-party reference video (blurred in the public copy); RIGHT = Claude Code's JavaScript remake on a new subject. 10:58.40 instead of 10:52: the cleanest moment where both pages are fully drawn (see s08-remake-1052). The on-screen labels at the frame top are cut off; the plate supplies the panel labels. The bubble covered a ~50 px sliver of the right page's right margin: rebuilt from the matching margin 620 px to the left, seamless-blended. Player controls below are cropped out.

shots.name: s08-remake-ref
shots.note: Left page alone (the reference video), for a plate with two separate portrait zones.

shots.name: s08-remake-ours
shots.note: Right page alone (Claude Code's remake), same scrub as s08-remake.

shots.name: s08-remake-1052
shots.note: ALT at the storyboard's 10:52: the left page's headline is still fading in (mid-animation). No clean moment exists within +-1 s of 10:52 because the left headline animates in slowly. Same crop and scrub as s08-remake.

shots.name: s09-styles
shots.note: README styles grid from the animate skill repo, untouched: 2 rows x 4 tiles (9:16), each with its numbered name below. No bubble.

shots.name: s09-styles-row
shots.note: The 8 tiles (cut-paper, crosshatch, riso, sketchbook, math, pixel, isometric, 'your look') in one row, names dropped (the plate's style-strip text names them). Dark ground = the source image's own background.

shots.name: s09-styles-grid
shots.note: Same 8 tiles, 2 rows x 4 columns, names dropped, tight 16 px gutters.

shots.name: s09-styles-row-cream
shots.note: Row variant on S11 cream (#FBF7EE) gutters with no outer margin, so the tiles sit straight on the plate's paper.
